monthly_review.summary: You've shifted toward higher-intensity running this month, with faster paces and more time in Zones 3–4, but at the cost of reduced volume and slightly lower aerobic efficiency. Overall training load intensity increased while total distance dropped significantly.
monthly_review.highlight: Your aerobic efficiency improved from 13.42 to 13.95 km/hr per bpm — the strongest positive signal this month, indicating better cardiovascular economy at given intensities.

goal_tracker.message: You need 19.3 more km across 4 remaining sessions (avg 4.8 km/session) to match last month’s volume — achievable with one long run (8–9 km), two moderate runs (4–5 km), and one short tempo (3–4 km).

insights.title: Improved efficiency despite higher HR
insights.body: Aerobic efficiency rose to 13.95 (from 13.42), even as average HR increased +8 bpm — suggesting enhanced stroke volume or metabolic adaptation, particularly notable given your best pace improved to 392 sec/km (6:32/km) this month.

insights.title: Zone distribution shifted sharply toward threshold work
insights.body: Time in Z3+Z4 jumped from 22% (19%+3%) last month to 46% (24%+22%) this month — a 24-point increase — while Z1+Z2 dropped from 79% to 51%, indicating a marked reduction in true recovery/easy running.

insights.title: Cadence and ground contact time improved under speed
insights.body: On your fastest recent run (3.0 km @ 6:32/km), cadence reached 162 spm and ground contact dropped to 274 ms — both personal highs in the dataset — suggesting neuromuscular adaptation to faster efforts.

insights.title: High-intensity density without volume buffer
insights.body: You ran 11.1 km (longest this month) at 9:17/km (551 sec/km) — solid endurance pace — yet followed it with a 3.0 km effort at 6:32/km just 4 days later, with only 6 total runs all month; recovery margin appears thin given low Z1/Z2 volume.

recommendations.action: Replace your next run with a 5.0 km Zone 2 run at ≤135 bpm (target avg HR 132–135), maintaining cadence ≥148 spm and pace ≤9:00/km (540 sec/km).
recommendations.reason: Your Z1+Z2 time dropped to 51% this month (vs 79% last month); rebuilding aerobic base is critical to sustain efficiency gains and avoid fatigue accumulation.

recommendations.action: Do a 4 × 90-sec stride drill post-run on Thursday: focus on landing midfoot, increasing cadence to 170 spm for each rep, with 90 sec walk recovery — track vertical oscillation and aim to hold ≤8.0 cm.
recommendations.reason: Vertical oscillation spiked to 9.2 cm during your 7:03/km effort (June 4), the highest in the dataset — indicating inefficiency at faster paces that can be corrected with targeted neuromuscular work.

recommendations.action: Add 3 minutes of post-run mobility: 1 min seated hamstring stretch (R/L), 1 min calf foam roll (R/L), 1 min diaphragmatic breathing (5-sec inhale/6-sec exhale) — do before logging the activity in Garmin.
recommendations.reason: Ground contact time decreased meaningfully (274 ms) only on your fastest run — improved recovery capacity supports such adaptations; current low volume (6 runs) makes daily recovery leverage high-value.

weekly_focus.description: Re-establish foundational Zone 1–2 volume to support your emerging efficiency and speed gains — prioritizing HR control, relaxed form, and consistency over intensity.
